label: Workato API token
name: workato_api_token
hint: Reads the error log data table and the state of the top recipes

label: Azure OpenAI key
name: azure_api_key
hint: Optional: an AI-written executive summary. Blank = the built-in insights only

label: To email
name: to_email
hint: Passed through to the to_email output (blank = alert_email)

label: Title
name: title
hint: Default: Workato Integrations Health

label: Subtitle
name: subtitle
hint: A line under the title

label: Note
name: note
hint: A message shown in a box under the header (simple HTML allowed), e.g. a maintenance window

label: Environment
name: env
hint: PROD, DEV, ... shown on the dashboard. Default PROD

label: Detail
name: detail
hint: brief, standard or full (default). Picks the set of sections

label: Sections
name: sections
hint: The exact sections, in order, comma separated. Blank = the detail set. Names: hero, kpis, insights, trend, weekly, recipes, movers, patterns, categories, systems, heatmap, calendar, records, recovery, backlog, noise, forecast, actions

label: Show sections
name: show_sections
hint: Sections to add to the detail set

label: Hide sections
name: hide_sections
hint: Sections to leave out

label: Timezone
name: timezone
hint: Decides what 'yesterday' and the hour of day are. Default America/Los_Angeles

label: Period
name: period
hint: rolling (default): the last period_days full days. calendar: the last complete week from week_start

label: Period length (days)
name: period_days
hint: Default 7 (1 to 31)

label: Period end
name: period_end
hint: YYYY-MM-DD: the last day of the period. Blank = yesterday

label: Include today
name: include_today
hint: Rolling period ends today instead of yesterday. Default no

label: Week starts on
name: week_start
hint: For period = calendar. Default monday

label: Trend length (periods)
name: trend_periods
hint: How many periods the trend and baselines use. Default 13 (91 days) (2 to 52)

label: Daily chart (days)
name: daily_days
hint: Days in the daily chart. Default 91 (7 to 120)

label: Heatmap length (periods)
name: heatmap_periods
hint: Periods in the weekday x hour heatmap. Default 13 (91 days) (1 to 52)

label: Top recipes
name: top_n
hint: Rows in the top failing recipes table. Default 10 (3 to 30)

label: Top patterns
name: patterns_n
hint: Rows in the error patterns table. Default 8 (3 to 25)

label: Movers per list
name: movers_n
hint: Default 5 (2 to 15)

label: Systems per list
name: systems_n
hint: Default 8 (3 to 20)

label: Max insights
name: max_insights
hint: Default 8. 0 = none (0 to 15)

label: Only these recipes
name: include_recipes
hint: Recipe ids or parts of names, comma separated. Blank = all

label: Leave out recipes
name: exclude_recipes
hint: Recipe ids or parts of names, comma separated

label: Only these systems
name: include_systems
hint: Parts of source or target system names, comma separated

label: Only these recipients
name: include_emails
hint: Rows whose Email contains one of these, comma separated

label: Leave out statuses
name: exclude_statuses
hint: e.g. Reprocessed

label: Merge system names
name: merge_system_names
hint: SFDC_Services, SFDC Services -> Salesforce Services. Default yes

label: Mask emails
name: mask_emails
hint: Show only team addresses (alert_email, config public_emails). Default yes

label: Show error examples
name: show_examples
hint: The latest message of each pattern. Default yes

label: Forecast
name: forecast
hint: Predict the next period (forecast section, tile, chart bars). Default no

label: Forecast method
name: forecast_method
hint: holt (default: damped trend), average (last 4 periods) or naive (last period)

label: Spike sensitivity
name: spike_z
hint: A day is a spike above median + this many robust deviations. Default 3.5 (1.5 to 10.0)

label: Rising threshold (%)
name: rising_pct
hint: A recipe is rising when up this much on the period before. Default 50 (10 to 1000)

label: Minimum change
name: min_change
hint: Ignore changes smaller than this many errors. Default 5 (1 to 1000)

label: Chronic after (periods)
name: chronic_periods
hint: Failing in this many of the last 8 periods = chronic. Default 6 (2 to 52)

label: Health score
name: health_score
hint: Show the 0-100 score and grade. Default yes

label: Recipe status
name: recipe_status
hint: Ask Workato if the top recipes are running and when they changed. Default yes

label: AI summary
name: ai
hint: Use Azure when azure_api_key is set. Default yes

label: Azure URL
name: azure_url
hint: Chat completions URL of the deployment

label: AI temperature
name: ai_temperature
hint: Default 0.2 (0.0 to 1.0)

label: AI max tokens
name: ai_max_tokens
hint: Default 900 (200 to 2000)

label: Redact for AI
name: ai_redact
hint: Take emails, URLs, ids and long numbers out before Azure sees them. Default yes

label: AI instructions
name: ai_instructions
hint: Extra notes for the AI, e.g. what the team cares about

label: Subject format
name: subject_format
hint: Placeholders: {emoji} {title} {env} {period} {errors} {previous} {change} {score} {grade} {recipes} {new_patterns} {forecast}

label: Skip if no errors
name: skip_if_empty
hint: send_email = false when the period has no errors. Default no

label: Brand color
name: brand_color
hint: Default #0056D2

label: Max width (px)
name: max_width
hint: Default 920 (600 to 1400)

label: Hover effects
name: hover_effects
hint: Cards lift, rows tint, pills deepen, bars dim under the mouse. Default yes

label: Hover row colour
name: hover_row_color
hint: The colour a row turns under the mouse. Default #EEF4FF

label: Logo URL
name: logo_url
hint: The Coursera logo. Blank = the word coursera

label: Workato logo URL
name: workato_logo_url
hint: Shown next to the Coursera logo. Blank = no Workato logo

label: Team logo URL
name: team_logo_url
hint: Shown after the Coursera (and Workato) logo, and in the footer

label: Alert email
name: alert_email
hint: Team address: footer Email link, never masked

label: Error log URL
name: error_log_url
hint: Blank = the data table in Workato

label: Dashboard URL
name: dashboard_url
hint: A live dashboard to link to

label: Data table id
name: data_table_id
hint: Default: Error Notification - TBL

label: Workato API base
name: workato_api_base
hint: Default https://www.workato.com/api

label: Page size
name: page_size
hint: Rows per data table page. The API documents 200 (default); up to 1000 is tried, and 200 is used again if the API refuses it (10 to 1000)

label: Parallel queries
name: parallel_queries
hint: Periods fetched at the same time. Default 4 (1 to 8)

label: Max rows
name: max_rows
hint: Stop reading after this many rows. Default 60000 (500 to 300000)

label: Time budget (s)
name: time_budget
hint: All lookups share it. Default 80 (10 to 85)

label: HTTP timeout (s)
name: http_timeout
hint: Default 20 (3 to 60)

label: HTML limit (KB)
name: html_limit_kb
hint: Gmail clips mail over ~102 KB: lists get shorter, then sections drop. 0 = no limit (0 to 5000)

label: Rows JSON
name: rows_json
hint: Testing: the table's rows as a JSON list, instead of reading the table

label: Config JSON
name: config_json
hint: Any setting above, plus table_columns, system_aliases, category_rules, titles, buttons, recipe_owners, known_issues, public_emails, score_weights, heat_colors

label: Now (testing)
name: now
hint: ISO time to build the dashboard as. Leave blank
